_comment: Upstream data-set config: every key, with a _comment_<key> note. Keys from 'dataset' down are read by the original config-driven scripts through imgt.load() (merged over the defaults in pipeline/code/imgt.py); 'pipeline' is read by scripts/run_upstream.py. Relative paths in dataset keys are relative to the run folder (the write root). Roots, environments and prefix aliases come from the voxel config (blocks 'upstream' and 'envs'); point upstream.dataset_config there at your copy of this file.

pipeline._comment: fold_target: cumulative number of receptors b2_fold_batch folds (capped at the folding set); primary_arm: the vector-method variant run by the vec2_primary_w050 step (vc_ori_w050 = per-chain frames + orientation at weight 0.50, the weight chosen by vec6); variant_arms: sensitivity variants run by vec2_cluster_tests.

_comment_species: any species in anarci.germlines (tested: mouse only)
_comment_locus_pair: AB (alpha/beta) or GD; chain labels and column names follow it (tested: AB only)
_comment_out_dir: stage B/C output folder; the vector-method scripts expect tables
_comment_columns: cell / donor / batch / library column names in the prepared tables

vdj._comment: contig filters; max_chains_per_cell is declared but not read by build_vdomains.py (dual-chain cells are removed in b1_prepare_deposit.py)

folding._comment: TCRBuilder2 (ImmuneBuilder) + OpenMM refinement; n_shards processes x threads each

benchmark._comment: crystal benchmark (b3b/b3h/b3i): resolution cut and the percentile used for the model-error threshold

clustering._comment: combining-site extraction / earlier-skill clustering settings (n_resample = points per loop in the site descriptor)

transcriptome._comment: transcriptome_map.py + c1b: QC, HVGs, PCA, Harmony, Leiden; receptor genes are excluded from the variable-gene pool

controls._comment: earlier-skill permutation settings; the vector method's own null ladder (200 permutations, default_rng(0)) is fixed in vec2_cluster_tests.py

deposit._comment: the 10x deposit files read by stages A-C (paths.deposit)

hashtag_names._comment: a3_hto_demux.py: the condition of a cell comes from its hashtag's sample name (the name column of the HTO feature file, else the matrix feature name; this name is also the mouse id): the name is split at separator and part number condition_field (0 = the first) is the condition. No default: a data set without this block stops.
